_source: The shape of OpenAI's own GPT-6 Intelligent UI film (S1-video-types-stories.md): five people, five areas of life, one shared enemy (the wall of text), one turn line, a collage of more uses. Cut to 30 s.
label: Bold
title: Words aren't enough
logline: Five everyday questions, five answers you can use.

actor.does: every person types into it; every answer grows out of it

critique.retell: It's the one where every kind of everyday question gets an answer you can use.

beats.name: Walls of text
beats.picture: Five people at five tables each get the same tall wall of text back in the composer.

beats.name: Words aren't enough
beats.picture: The walls of text fold away into the composer.

beats.name: Paint
beats.picture: Swatches appear on a photo of the hallway; a tap tries each one.
ui: tap a swatch → the hallway changes colour

beats.name: Walk
beats.picture: A city guide builds as a map with stops along a route.
ui: drag the route → the stops reorder

beats.name: Origami
beats.picture: A paper crane folds step by step in an interactive diagram.
ui: tap next → the paper folds once more

beats.name: Bike
beats.picture: A child's bike assembles part by part in a 3D guide.
ui: tap a part → it slides into place

beats.name: Garden
beats.picture: A backyard plan with beds you can drag and a sun path.
ui: drag a bed → the sun hours update

beats.name: And more
beats.picture: A collage of fifteen more answers as small working tools.

beats.name: Ask ChatGPT
beats.picture: The end line, the largest type in the film, then the mark.
